description: This file defines a Java interface 'COBBusinessStep' with type parameter extending 'AbstractPersistableCustom'. It declares methods relevant to executing a business step and retrieving its names.

classes.name: COBBusinessStep
classes.description: An interface representing a business step within the Context of the COB (Cloud Object Business) system, parameterized with a type extending 'AbstractPersistableCustom'. Defines methods for executing the step and retrieving its names.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the business step with the given input of type T, returning a result of the same type.

methods.name: getEnumStyledName
methods.description: Returns the name of the business step in an enum style (likely uppercase with underscores).

methods.name: getHumanReadableName
methods.description: Returns a human-readable name for the business step.
